aria: Animated recap of the Suns' 101 to 96 home win over the Hornets: Devin Booker's 28-foot step-back 3-pointer in the final 30 seconds that made it 97 to 91, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Booker's 30 points, the top scorers, how the Suns won, and the next game against the Lakers.

notes: Box score from the Suns' 101–96 win over the Charlotte Hornets at Mortgage Matchup Center on Nov 12, 2026, from the Land of Basketball and Covers box scores (every player line matches), with game details from the Associated Press (via InfoNews), Field Level Media (via Yardbarker), Arizona Sports and Yahoo Sports. All 101 Phoenix points and all 96 Charlotte points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (55–50 at the half, matching Field Level Media). Phoenix's 17-point lead came at 48–31 midway through the second quarter (AP; Field Level Media also has 17). Rebounds (52–31 Charlotte), turnovers (25 by Charlotte, 7 by Phoenix) and steals (11–4) are the sums of the player lines in both box scores; Field Level Media also has 25 Charlotte turnovers. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Thursday's games: Phoenix 5–6 and 11th in the West, the Lakers 11–2.

Phoenix closed the first quarter on an 18–7 run, Charlotte went on a 33–11 run to lead 76–72 after three, and Phoenix won the fourth 29–20 (Field Level Media; line score). Booker scored 13 in the first quarter (AP, Field Level Media). Coby White's 21 was a season high (Field Level Media); he played 20 minutes. It was Miles Bridges' first game against Charlotte, where he played his first seven seasons (AP, Field Level Media). Phoenix has won four of five after a 1–5 start (AP, Field Level Media) and hosts the Lakers on Sunday (AP, Field Level Media).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Devin Booker's 28-foot step-back 3-pointer (Arizona Sports) that put Phoenix up 97–91 (AP, Field Level Media). The AP and Yahoo Sports put it at 28 seconds left; Field Level Media has 23.8 seconds, so the recap says only that it came in the final 30 seconds and the scoreboard in the drawing shows no clock. Royce O'Neale's four-point play cut it to 97–95, and Bridges and Booker made two free throws each to close it out (AP, Field Level Media). The template draws a plain pull-up, not the step-back. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Phoenix Suns or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Booker's listed 6-foot-5 and 206 pounds (RealGM), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-8¼ wingspan at the 2015 draft combine (theScore), in Phoenix's home white with No. 1, with his proposed look from the site's look sheet. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
